description: A synthesizer python block emits a repeating nRF Enhanced ShockBurst frame (address e7e7e7e7e7, 8-byte payload); packet_decode syncs on the address, reads the PCF and verifies the CRC-8. The decoded packets (payload, PID, CRC status) and the packet count are shown live.
prompt: Decode Enhanced ShockBurst packets from a bit stream.

params.code:
def work(x, rate):
    addr = bytes.fromhex('e7e7e7e7e7')
    payload = bytes(range(1, 9))
    pcf = len(payload) | (1 << 6)
    body = np.concatenate([modem.unpack_bits_lsb(addr),
                           np.array([(pcf >> i) & 1 for i in range(9)], dtype=np.uint8),
                           modem.unpack_bits_lsb(payload)])
    crc = modem.esb_crc8(addr + bytes([pcf & 0xFF, (pcf >> 8) & 0xFF]) + payload)
    frame = np.concatenate([body, modem.unpack_bits_lsb(bytes([crc]))])
    n = len(x)
    return np.tile(frame, n // len(frame) + 1)[:n].astype(float), rate
